allow: Bash(sed -i -e 's/^# DB_HOST=.*/DB_HOST=127.0.0.1/' -e 's/^# DB_PORT=.*/DB_PORT=3306/' -e 's/^# DB_DATABASE=.*/DB_DATABASE=rwaq_db/' -e 's/^# DB_USERNAME=.*/DB_USERNAME=root/' -e 's/^# DB_PASSWORD=.*/DB_PASSWORD=/' .env)
Bash(mysql -uroot -e "CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS rwaq_db CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci")

Bash(mysql -uroot rwaq_db -e "select count\(*\) users from users; select count\(*\) books from books; select count\(*\) libs from libraries; select id,name,category,cover_image from books limit 5; select id,name,email,role from users limit 5")

Bash(mysql -uroot rwaq_db -e "select count\(*\) users from users; select count\(*\) books from books; select count\(*\) libs from libraries; select id,title,category,cover_image from books limit 5; select id,name,email,role from users limit 5")

Bash(mysql -uroot rwaq_db -e "select id,title,author,category,total_pages,cover_color,left\(description,40\) d from books; select id,name,type,is_personal from libraries; select count\(*\) from communities; select count\(*\) from challenges; select count\(*\) from book_copies" --default-character-set=utf8mb4)
